subject.title: fix(cli): bound --message-file reads for agent command

question: Should shipped `openclaw agent --message-file` continue accepting symlinks to regular prompt files while adding the size cap, or may this hardening intentionally reject symlinked message-file paths?
rationale: The OOM cap is a narrow safety fix, but rejecting symlinked prompt paths changes a shipped CLI contract and needs explicit maintainer intent if that stricter boundary is desired.

options.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
options.body: Use a bounded read of the opened target file so symlinks to regular prompt files continue working while oversized targets are rejected.

options.title: Reject symlinks intentionally
options.body: Keep the stricter helper behavior only with maintainer approval, explicit tests, and release-note context for the breaking path rule.

recommendation.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
recommendation.body: Use a bounded read of the opened target file so symlinks to regular prompt files continue working while oversized targets are rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the shipped feature PR that established this CLI surface and are the strongest history-backed routing candidate for the compatibility choice.
